_the_hostile_referee_objection_worth_car: The strongest objection a referee would actually press — a design paper with no experiment, whose panel-level result is null against a chimeric baseline, resting on a cut the paper itself calls a convention, and at which both named reagents sit one to two base pairs inside — is real. That seat's own verdict is that the paper raises every part of it in its own text and concedes it at full strength, making it an editorial question of fit rather than a defect that stops the paper. Recorded because a later round should not rediscover it as new.
